Checking the results:

- Model: label photo is legible and shows SE4570 (T1, T2), a recalled model. Confirmed.
- Date code: typed "08/22 NH" matches the recalled code 08/22 NH by text, but check_date_code returned "unparsed" (T3). The label reading also gives date code text "08/22", which is consistent with the recalled range. The program's date code rule only excludes codes outside the recalled ones; the typed value and label agree on 08/22 NH. This is not a clear out-of-range value, so it does not trigger a deny. Serial/date code rules apply only as stated; the date code is present, so it is not missing and does not trigger needs_info on its own.
- Purchase: justinboots.com is on the list, purchase date 2023-09-30 is inside the window (T4). Receipt not required, but one was attached anyway.
- Destruction: not required (remedy is replacement) (T5).
- Duplicates: none (T6), so no flag.

No rule triggers deny, needs_info, or flag. The claim is approved for replacement. The unparsed date code is a minor data-quality point, but the label photo independently shows 08/22, which matches the recalled range, so I'm recording slightly lower confidence.
